hero.currentRole: Mobile Expert & Systems Architect @ ueno bank
hero.overviewP1: I'm a Mobile Expert, Systems Architect, and Electronics Engineer with over 14 years of end-to-end software engineering, hardware telemetry, and AI-accelerated delivery experience. I specialize in designing, modernizing, and scaling mission-critical platforms using Flutter (BLoC & Riverpod), Python (FastAPI), Java (Spring Boot), Google Cloud Platform, and Multi-Agent AI Engineering.
hero.overviewP2: At ueno bank (ITTI S.A.E.C.A.), I lead mobile architecture for 50+ Flutter engineers, orchestrating the migration to a modular Micro-App & App Shell ecosystem, pioneering multi-agent AI development workflows (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Spec-Driven Development), harmonizing retail & corporate apps, establishing a 15-day multi-store release train, and hardening security with Fintech RASP. My career spans delivering 100% backend test coverage with FastAPI at PairTree (adoption platform), building scalable Nest.js & Riverpod apps at Tandamos, powering enterprise GCP Pub/Sub microservices at Valtech, and a decade of full-stack engineering with zero mobile store rejections.

about.title: Systems Engineering Rooted in
about.subtitle: A software engineer who bridges electrical hardware fundamentals with high-scale mobile architecture and distributed cloud backends.
about.bioP1: Hello! I'm Eugenio Tesio, a Mobile Expert, Systems Architect, and Electronics Engineer with more than 14 years of end-to-end software delivery and hardware systems engineering.
about.bioP2: Currently at ueno bank (ITTI S.A.E.C.A.), I lead mobile architecture for 50+ Flutter engineers, migrating legacy monoliths into an independent Micro-App & App Shell ecosystem, harmonizing BLoC and Riverpod across unified retail and corporate banking products, orchestrating 15-day automated release trains across 3 app stores, and enforcing Fintech RASP threat defense.
about.bioP3: Prior to ueno bank, I delivered mission-critical FastAPI Python backends with 100% test coverage and Flutter apps with golden UI tests at PairTree (adoption enablement platform), built cross-platform Riverpod apps and Nest.js / TypeScript microservices at Tandamos, and engineered high-throughput Spring Boot microservices on Google Cloud Platform at Valtech.
about.bioP4: Holding a formal Electrical & Electronics Engineering degree from Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN), my engineering intuition extends from serial buses (RS485 Modbus) and EV charging protocols (OCPP 1.6) to cloud microservices and modern multi-agent AI workflows.
about.quote: "I look for innovative Python & Flutter projects where architectural patterns, rigorous test coverage, and automated release trains convert complex business challenges into reliable, high-scale engineering engines."
about.capstoneDesc: An electronic telemetry device engineered for Vulcano Lubricación. It reads industrial equipment data over an RS485 differential bus, transmits packet streams over Ethernet or Wi-Fi, and stores metrics into databases for downstream monitoring.
about.capstoneNote: Commissioned by the company and became part of a commercialized product.
about.electronicsDesc: Understanding signal integrity, hardware interrupts, and serial communication creates a developer who writes remarkably robust, leak-free Flutter code and resilient distributed backend APIs.
about.seekingProjects: Seeking innovative Python & Flutter projects where architecture and scale matter.
